name: T20 Cricket
description: Come and join the T20 cricket game! It takes place in a busy stadium with excited fans. The game is played on a green field. Pick the Bangladesh cricket team and show off your amazing skills and strategies. In this game, the bowler runs quickly towards the wicket and throws the ball fast. You have to play the role of the batsman and have to react quickly and either defend the ball or hit it hard. Showcase your cricket skills in front of others in your group.
